title: Understanding Silhouette Scores
text: A silhouette score measures how similar a point is to its own cluster compared to other clusters. A negative silhouette score indicates that a point might be closer to a neighboring cluster than to its own cluster.

title: Analyzing Clustering C
text: Look at the points in Clustering C. Are there any points that seem closer to a different cluster than their own? This might indicate a negative silhouette score.
